release_notes:
Telegram catalog feed photos + on-demand cron trigger tool

Two updates:

1. Catalog feed alerts (price change / new service / offline) on Telegram now include a photo — either the service's own category image, or a generated banner card when there isn't one. Also now fires correctly when you manually enable/disable a service or edit prices in bulk, not just on automatic supplier changes.

2. New "System Tools" page (renamed from "Refresh API Orders" in the admin menu) lets you manually trigger any of the site's background jobs on demand — e.g. force an order-send or price-sync run right now instead of waiting for its next scheduled time.
